## Community Spotlight: VIA Centers for Neurodevelopment


Virginia National Bank is proud to support **[VIA Centers for Neurodevelopment](https://viacenters.org/)** (VIA) as they celebrate 30 years in the Central and Southwest Virginia region. Ethan Long, VIA's President & CEO, discusses with Sherry Taylor, of VNB, the important work they do in our community and why their new facility is going to elevate the care they currently give to their students and families.


Join us in supporting VIA as they open their new facility in November and find out more about its impact on our **[new podcast episode](https://www.buzzsprout.com/admin/2632965/episodes/19983263-community-spotlight-via-centers-for-neurodevelopment) .**
